ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; remind the driver that a "no-show" cancellation requires continuous wait on-location beyond 3 minutes from the "I'm Here" tap/arrival before the rider can be charged.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat is limited to a pickup arrangement and a cancellation notice [F9][F10]; no threat, abuse, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation appears in any chat message, the complaint or the driver statement [F12]. safety_concern = none.

Branch: the driver cancelled and claims the rider was a no-show, so NS-0 routes this to NS-1/NS-2. NS-1 requires all of (i) arrival confirmed, (ii) driver within 200 m of pickup at that moment, and (iii) a continuous wait of more than 3 minutes on-location after arrival. (i) and (ii) hold: the platform recorded arrival at 14:13:25 and the tap at 14:14:10 placed the driver 41 m from pickup [F5][F6][F3][F1]. But (iii) fails: at the tap the driver had to wait >3 min (≥3:01); the record shows only 1 min 40 s within 200 m after the tap [F6], and cumulative in-range time before cancellation was 2 min 25 s [F2], with cancellation at 14:15:50, i.e. 2 min 25 s after arrival [F4][F5]. The driver's own chat "3 min up" [F10] contradicts the GPS/timeline record, and the platform-timeline record overrides statements; in any event 14:14:10 → 14:15:50 is 1 min 40 s. Since (iii) is not satisfied, NS-1 does not hold and NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee [F7] must be refunded in full. No GPS gap issue arises — the driver was stationary and continuously tracked 14:13:50–14:15:50 [F3]. NS-2's account flag is limited to a tap made while GPS shows the driver outside 200 m; here the tap was at 41 m [F6], so no flag. RD-6 is not applicable (no route-deviation finding). The driver's "no-show" claim is rejected on the timer arithmetic.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's claim of a completed no-show wait is contradicted by the platform timeline/GPS: only 2 min 25 s elapsed between recorded arrival (14:13:25) and cancellation (14:15:50), and only 1 min 40 s of in-range time after the 'I'm Here' tap (14:14:10) — short of the >3-minute continuous-wait requirement in NS-1 (iii).
Driver's chat '3 min up' is a statement inconsistent with the timed record; the timeline (arrival 14:13:25, cancel 14:15:50) does not support a 3-minute wait after arrival.
